instruction: A cinematic fashion portrait photograph in a medium shot at eye-level, set in a minimalist indoor studio with a plain beige wall. On the left, the red-haired woman in the white tank top and beige trousers (R1) stands in profile facing right, leaning her chest against the back of the blonde woman in the white v-neck t-shirt and black pants (R2). The red-haired woman (R1) places her left hand, which features a rose tattoo, onto the blonde woman's (R2) upper arm. The blonde woman (R2) stands facing forward, looking slightly to the right with a serious, neutral expression. Harsh, direct sunlight streams from the upper left, casting sharp diagonal shadows across the subjects and the background wall, creating a warm, muted color palette.
